purpose: Diagnostic only, selected known misses; not fresh validation. No reclassification, training, or threshold changes.
history: Full original PGN move stack, fresh game session and Clear Hash per query
unrestricted_method: AST-extracted packed/search from frozen collector, same-depth current/previous
mapping: Scores white-oriented; mover sign; cp clamped +/-1000, mate sign mapped +/-1000; 100/(1+exp(-0.00368208*mapped_cp)); loss is before best minus after best in percentage points, signed and clipped shown
caveat: Forced played-only search has separate search context and is not guaranteed a fair comparison with unrestricted MultiPV or after-position search. Larger node budget can change principal variations without resolving classifier gates.
